description: Conceptual AI editorial illustrations, not documentary evidence. One generation per asset, no retries.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: widescreen editorial illustration for Current, a calm personalized news channel.
Primary request: a dreamy yet scientifically inspired conceptual deep-space star nursery inspired by the idea of IC 348, an original imagined celestial composition, not a replica of a Webb photograph.
Scene/backdrop: blue-black space with dusty indigo molecular clouds, delicate wispy layered nebula filaments and a few amber luminous young stars.
Style/medium: sophisticated atmospheric editorial illustration with tactile cinematic detail and visibly artistic painterly treatment; beautiful quiet light, rich natural contrast.
Composition/framing: full-bleed landscape exactly 16:9 aspect ratio, wide celestial expanse with main cloud structure and luminous star accents toward upper center/right; enough dark lower-left quiet area for a headline overlay added later.
Color palette: cool indigo and teal, blue-black, restrained warm amber accents, no excessive saturation.
Constraints: no text, no logos, no UI, no watermark, no people. This will be labeled an AI illustration; it must read as conceptual art rather than actual telescope evidence or documentation. Generate one image.
